title: fix(storage): committing/diffing error handling logic
body:
<!--- Please read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/containers/container-libs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) before proceeding --->

Fixes #1278.
Where committing/diffing a layer inside a FreeBSD jail silently produced an empty layer when listing the system extattr namespace returned `EPERM`.

The FreeBSD listxattr surfaced the jail's EPERM instead of ignoring it for the non-user namespace, and the archive packer then treated that per-file error as "skip this entry", so every file was dropped and the operation still reported success.

This PR implements a clear error-handling policy for xattr reads during packing:
* EPERM on the system namespace -> Skip the xattr, keep the file
* EPERM on the user namespace -> Fail loudly
* ENOENT (file vanished mid-walk) -> Skip the file quietly
* Any other error -> Fail loudly

comments.body:
I have tested all kinds of combinations on FreeBSD-15.1 now (in a vnet jail with `allow.extattr=false`).

Both fixes seem fine and, as I have figured out how to build and test that now, I can easily re-test.

## podman's `main` branch with container-libs `main` branch

- Unpatched: Errors are skipped and not printed (without verbose logging). Container build fails with hard to understand errors ("entrypoint not found" after `ADD entrypoint` succeeded). 
- https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1300/changes/307c8cccc291621ea744d2ec74b1c70ada417187 cherry picked: The container build aborts and a single error is printed giving a proper message about the `EPERM` when reading extended attributes
- https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1300/changes/71a5af9422c8c8aa4d19928c19898fa7138fe05d cherry picked: everything works

## podman's `v5.8` branch with container-libs `podman-5.8` branch (last with `CNI` support)

Both commits applied cleanly. I only had to add one import to `xattrs_freebsd.go` and some more changes to the `xattrs_freebsd_test.go` to make it compile.

- Unpatched: The container build succeeded but pulling a container logged one `ERROR` per file (all ignored) and `podman run` finally fails because (obviously) the executable cannot be found.
- https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1300/changes/307c8cccc291621ea744d2ec74b1c70ada417187 cherry picked: The pull aborts and a single error is printed giving a proper message about the `EPERM` when reading extended attributes

```
Writing manifest to image destination
Error: creating container storage: creating read-write layer with ID "46f9bcb7092f2683a56ffcb1f7da29a778871b488cef7add60c42f95f321e258": adding file "COPYRIGHT" in "/var/db/containers/storage/vfs/dir/d8ef77f70a0ec65b949217ad5afc7b6217f3094ec67af4f76d5e26fbb7b6d708" to tar: extattr_list_fd /var/db/containers/storage/vfs/dir/d8ef77f70a0ec65b949217ad5afc7b6217f3094ec67af4f76d5e26fbb7b6d708/COPYRIGHT: operation not permitted
```

- https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1300/changes/71a5af9422c8c8aa4d19928c19898fa7138fe05d cherry picked: everything works
